name: Casselberry Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at Lake Concord Park
venue: Lake Concord Park, behind City Hall
paras: The City of Casselberry hosts its annual tree lighting ceremony on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM at Lake Concord Park, behind City Hall at 95 Triplet Lake Drive. The city lists admission as free.
The city describes a night of great singing and holiday festivities. Various schools perform, and Santa Claus shows up to turn on the Christmas tree lights behind City Hall.

Besides the singing, there is a host of children's activities and vendors, and families can take free portrait style photos with Santa using their own cameras. Parking is available at adjacent businesses.
tip: Bring your own camera for the free photos with Santa and park at the adjacent businesses.

name: Casselberry Holiday Art and Music in the Park and Berry Bazaar
paras: The City of Casselberry hosts a special Holiday Art & Music in the Park and Food Trucks night, also called the Berry Bazaar, on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 6 to 9 PM at Lake Concord Park, 95 Triplet Lake Drive. The city lists the cost as free.
The city says there will be live music, Santa Claus available for photos, 10 food trucks and many holiday vendors.
The city calls it a great night of holiday music and shopping just two weeks before Christmas.
tip: Come hungry for the food trucks and plan your photo with Santa early in the evening.
